_comment: The word on the street at the diner: what the rivals did today. Each pool gives one line at random.
{name} is the racer, {nickname} their nickname as it is said (' "Flathead"', or nothing), {possessive}
his/her/their, {car} the car. Other values are named in the lines that use them.

lines.street.broke_quit: {name} went broke one time too many and quit the scene.
lines.street.broke: {name} is broke and scraped {cash:money} together to get back on the street.
lines.street.king_out: {name} has heard about you. He's at the diner, and he only races for pink slips.
lines.street.no_car: {name} has no car and is sitting it out.
lines.street.car_impounded: The police have {name}'s {car} in the impound; {name} is sitting it out.
lines.street.car_laid_up: {name}'s {car} is laid up; {name} is sitting it out.
lines.street.gave_up: {name} gave up on {possessive} {car} and quit the scene.
lines.street.impound_collected: {name} got {possessive} {car} back from the police impound.
lines.street.impound_auctioned: {name} never collected {possessive} {car}: the police auctioned it off.
lines.street.sold_scrap: {name} sold the wreck of {possessive} {car} for scrap.
lines.street.bought_ad: {name} bought {seller}'s {car} out of the paper for {price:money}.
lines.street.tuned_cooling: {name} put a {change} on {possessive} {car} to keep it cool.
lines.street.new_face_car: A new face at the diner: {name}{nickname}, in a {car}.
lines.street.new_face: A new face at the diner: {name}{nickname}.
lines.street.grudge: {name} wants {possessive} {car} back from {player}, and tells anyone who'll listen.
lines.street.grudge_settled: {name} got even with {player} in a pink-slip rematch.
lines.street.grudge_dropped: {name} has stopped talking about getting {possessive} {car} back.
lines.street.bought_players_car: {name} bought {player}'s car out of the paper.
lines.street.rivals.pink_wreck: {loser} wrecked the {car} racing {winner} for pink slips; {winner} towed away what's left of it.
lines.street.rivals.pink: {winner} took {loser}'s {car} in a pink slip race.
lines.street.rivals.wreck: {loser} wrecked the {car} in a {raceType} race against {winner}.
